objectives.text: Find the card with two black diamonds that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a rock is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one green heart that a short yellow house that is next to a tall blue house is next to.
Find the card with two orange plusses that a short blue house that is beside a tall blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one blue circle that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a tall grey house is beside.
Find the card with two black plusses that a short grey house that is next to a short yellow house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue squares that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a short red house is beside.
Find the card with one blue diamond that a tall red house that is next to a tall blue house is beside.
Find the card with two green stars that a short red house that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with two blue hearts that a tall grey house that is next to a tree is next to.
Find the card with one green star that a tree that is next to a short red house is next to.
Find the card with one orange diamond that a short blue house that is 2 tiles from a short grey house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue plusses that a tall grey house that is 3 tiles from a short green house is next to.
Find the card with two red stars that a short yellow house that is beside another short yellow house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one red plus that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from a tall grey house is beside.
Find the card with two orange stars that a short red house that is next to a tall grey house is beside.
